# Structa Global

> Structa Global curates and delivers certified façade systems, structural components, interior finishes and sustainable building materials for architects, contractors and developers in the USA, Canada, the UK and India. Founded in Kochi, Kerala, in 2004. Tagline: Engineered Trust. Delivered.

- Headquarters: KK Buildings, Thoundayil Road, Panampilly Nagar, Kochi, Kerala 682 036, India
- Phone: +91 99471 06111 · Email: hello@structaglobal.com · Hours: Monday to Saturday, 9:00 to 18:00 IST
- Kerala service areas: Kochi (HQ, since 2004), Thiruvananthapuram and Thrissur (since 2010), Kozhikode and Kottayam (since 2020)
- Quality: ISO 9001:2015 quality management; CE, BIS and ASTM tested products; product data for IGBC, LEED and GRIHA credits
- Response time: within one business day

Questions
### What specifiers ask first.
More detail in our Insights , or ask the technical team directly.
What does Structa Global supply?
Structa Global supplies certified architectural building materials in six categories: façade systems, structural components, interior finishes, sustainable materials, roofing and waterproofing, and architectural hardware. Every product carries its test reports and certificates.
Where does Structa Global work?
We support projects in the USA, Canada, the UK and India. Our headquarters is in Panampilly Nagar, Kochi, with dedicated service areas in Kochi, Trivandrum, Thrissur, Kozhikode and Kottayam.
Which certifications do your products carry?
Our quality management system is certified to ISO 9001:2015. Depending on the product, materials carry CE marking with a Declaration of Performance, BIS certification to the relevant IS code, and ASTM test data. We also supply the product data used for IGBC, LEED and GRIHA credits.
How quickly do you respond to a specification request?
Within one business day. You receive product data sheets, certificates, honest lead times and an itemised quotation.
What are typical lead times?
Stocked products reach sites in Kochi and Ernakulam in 2 to 5 working days, and elsewhere in Kerala in 3 to 7. Imported standard products take 4 to 8 weeks, and custom specifications 8 to 16 weeks. We confirm exact dates at quotation.

# Our Story | Structa Global, Since 2004
URL: https://www.structaglobal.com/our-story/

- Home 
- About 
- Our story
Our story
## Rooted in Kochi. Built for the World.
Structa Global began with one conviction: a fast-growing construction market deserved a supplier that understood both international quality standards and the conditions of the site. Twenty years later, that conviction is how we work in four markets.
The beginning
### A supplier that understood the site.
In 2004, South India was building at pace. What it lacked was a supplier who combined certified international products with knowledge of local climate, codes and site realities.
We started in Kochi by building relationships on both sides: with manufacturers who would open their quality systems to audit, and with the architects, contractors and developers shaping Kerala's skyline. We learned the salt air of Kochi and Kozhikode, the monsoon intensity of Thrissur, the thermal load of Trivandrum and the humidity of Kottayam's backwaters.
That knowledge became the method. Specify to the site, document everything and stay until the building performs. It is the same method we now apply to projects in the USA, Canada and the UK.
Milestones
### Two decades of Engineered Trust.
- 2004 
#### Founded in Kochi
Structa Global opens in Panampilly Nagar, Kochi, to bring internationally certified architectural materials to South India's construction sector.
- 2007 
#### First international partnerships
Supply agreements with certified manufacturers in Europe and Asia set the documentation standard we still apply to every product.
- 2010 
#### Trivandrum and Thrissur
Dedicated teams in two more Kerala cities shorten specification support and delivery times for design teams statewide.
- 2014 
#### One hundred projects
Our hundredth project, a residential tower in Kochi, marks a decade of façade and structural supply.
- 2017 
#### Green building division
A dedicated sustainability portfolio and specification service for IGBC, LEED and GRIHA projects.
- 2020 
#### Kozhikode and Kottayam
Two further service areas complete our five-city Kerala network.
- 2024 
#### Twenty years
More than 500 projects supplied and over 200 certified products in the portfolio.
- 2026 
#### A new identity
Structa Global introduces a new brand and a four-market footprint: the USA, Canada, the UK and India.
Looking ahead
### The next chapter.
We are growing the sustainable share of our portfolio to at least 50% by 2027, deepening our technical consulting and extending the same standard of documentation to every market we serve.
Our sustainability commitments

# Sustainability | IGBC, LEED and GRIHA Materials | Structa Global
URL: https://www.structaglobal.com/sustainability/

- Home 
- Sustainability
Sustainability
## Sustainability Is Structural.
Low-carbon, responsibly sourced and documented for green rating systems by default. We help each project earn the IGBC, LEED or GRIHA credits it is targeting, with evidence an assessor will accept.
40% Of the portfolio eco-certified 
100+ Green-rated projects supplied 
3 Rating systems documented 
2027 Target: 50% eco-certified 
Commitments
### Four ways we make green easier to specify.
- 01 
#### Low-carbon sourcing
We prioritise manufacturers who publish Environmental Product Declarations and reduce embodied carbon, verified by third-party audit. Lifecycle carbon is part of every specification conversation.
- 02 
#### Certified timber
Every timber and wood product carries FSC certification with full chain-of-custody traceability.
- 03 
#### Credit-ready documentation
Our sustainability team maps products to the credits your project is targeting and assembles the submission data, from Materials and Resources to Indoor Environmental Quality.
- 04 
#### Responsible logistics
Consolidated, route-planned deliveries across our Kerala service areas reduce transport emissions. We are evaluating electric last-mile delivery for urban sites.
Rating systems
### Which framework, and what we provide.
For a full comparison of thresholds and project fit, read our guide to IGBC, LEED and GRIHA .
Framework Administered by Typical projects What we provide 
IGBC Indian Green Building Council (CII) Most private commercial, residential, institutional and hospitality projects in India Material data for the Materials and Resources and Indoor Environmental Quality credits 
LEED US Green Building Council Corporate campuses, IT parks and international clients; standard in the USA and Canada EPDs, material ingredient disclosures, recycled content and low-emitting materials data 
GRIHA TERI and the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy Government and public-sector buildings in India Embodied-energy, low-VOC and local-material data for GRIHA criteria 
Questions
### Green building, answered.
Are IGBC, LEED and GRIHA product certifications?
No. IGBC, LEED and GRIHA rate whole buildings, not individual products. Materials contribute to credits, and we supply the evidence each credit asks for: Environmental Product Declarations, recycled-content and regional-sourcing data, VOC test reports, FSC chain-of-custody certificates and thermal performance data.
What share of the Structa Global portfolio is eco-certified?
Around 40% of our products currently carry a recognised environmental certification or declaration. Our commitment is to reach at least 50% by 2027.
Do you supply FSC-certified timber?
Yes. All timber and wood products in our portfolio carry FSC certification with chain-of-custody documentation.

# Certifications | ISO 9001, CE, BIS, ASTM | Structa Global
URL: https://www.structaglobal.com/certifications/

- Home 
- Certifications
Verified. Tested. Documented.
## Every product. Every standard.
We certify quality rather than claim it. Every material in the Structa Global portfolio has independent test evidence, and every delivery arrives with the documents your project file needs.
Standards
### What each certification confirms.
Standard Scope What it confirms Applies to 
ISO 9001:2015 Quality management Our quality management system: sourcing, inspection, storage, delivery and after-sales support. Company-wide 
CE marking European conformity Conformity with harmonised European standards, backed by a Declaration of Performance. Curtain walling is assessed under EN 13830. Façades, structural steel, hardware 
BIS Bureau of Indian Standards Compliance with the applicable IS code for products sold in India, for example IS 733 for aluminium sections and IS 14900 for float glass. Structural, roofing, waterproofing, glazing 
ASTM ASTM International Material testing to ASTM methods, recognised in the USA, Canada and many international specifications. Structural steel, glass, membranes 
IGBC · LEED · GRIHA Green building rating systems These rate buildings, not products. We supply the product data that earns credits under each system. Sustainable range, façades, interiors 
Quality assurance
### Four stages before anything reaches site.
No product enters the portfolio, and no order leaves the factory, without clearing each stage.
- 01 
#### Manufacturer qualification
We audit the manufacturer's quality system, production process, certification status and export record before any product is listed.
- 02 
#### Independent testing
Claimed performance is checked against third-party laboratory reports. A manufacturer's datasheet alone is never enough.
- 03 
#### Pre-shipment inspection
Major orders are inspected at the factory for conformity, quantity, packaging and completeness of documents.
- 04 
#### Delivery and documentation
Every delivery arrives with its certification pack, so traceability is complete for your project records.
The documentation pack
### What arrives with every delivery.
Need a document before you order? We send certificates with every quotation.
- Material test reports from accredited laboratories
- Mill certificates with heat or batch traceability
- CE Declaration of Performance (DoP)
- BIS certificates and IS code compliance letters
- IGBC, LEED and GRIHA product contribution data
- Safety data sheets (SDS)
- Manufacturer warranty documentation

# Architectural Building Materials in Kochi | Structa Global
URL: https://www.structaglobal.com/locations/kochi/

- Home 
- Locations 
- Kochi
Headquarters · Central Kerala
## Architectural building materials in Kochi.
Our headquarters and longest-standing service area. We supply façade systems, structural components, interior finishes and green building materials to architects, contractors and developers across Ernakulam district.
Our headquarters
### Where every Structa Global specification begins.
Structa Global was founded in Panampilly Nagar in 2004, and Kochi is still where our technical, sustainability and logistics teams sit. Specifications for every Kerala service area are prepared here.
Kochi's waterfront and port districts put most projects within a few kilometres of the Arabian Sea and the backwaters. Salt-laden air, year-round humidity and intense monsoon exposure shape every specification we write for the city.
Typical projects: Waterfront residences, commercial towers, hospitality, port and logistics buildings, and mixed-use developments.
Serving
Ernakulam district and Greater Kochi
Address
KK Buildings, Thoundayil Road, Panampilly Nagar, Kochi 682 036
Phone
+91 99471 06111 
Email
hello@structaglobal.com 
Hours
Monday to Saturday, 9:00 to 18:00 IST
Standards
ISO 9001:2015 · CE · BIS · ASTM · IGBC, LEED and GRIHA data
Local intelligence
### What Kochi asks of a specification.
Three considerations we raise on almost every project here.
- 01 
#### Chloride exposure
Within roughly 1 to 5 km of the shoreline, specify Grade 316 stainless fixings as a minimum and marine-grade anodising or high-performance PVDF on aluminium.
- 02 
#### Monsoon water ingress
Façades should be tested for water tightness under pressure (CWCT or AAMA methods) at the design wind pressure for the site and height.
- 03 
#### Biological growth
Persistent humidity encourages algae on shaded elevations. Choose self-cleaning or low-porosity finishes and specify a maintenance regime.
What we supply
### Six categories, available in Kochi.
Stocked products reach Kochi and Ernakulam sites in 2 to 5 working days. Imported and custom lead times are confirmed at quotation.
- 01 
#### Façade systems
Curtain walling, unitised façades, rainscreen cladding and solar-control glazing, selected for Kochi's exposure and the building's wind load.
- 02 
#### Structural components
Structural steel, composite systems and load-bearing assemblies with BIS certification and heat-number traceability.
- 03 
#### Interior finishes
Surface materials, acoustic systems, flooring and feature finishes for hospitality, workplace and residential interiors.
- 04 
#### Sustainable materials
Low-carbon alternatives, FSC-certified timber and high-performance envelopes, documented for IGBC, LEED and GRIHA.
- 05 
#### Roofing and waterproofing
Membrane systems and standing-seam metal roofing for Kerala's monsoon and humidity.
- 06 
#### Hardware and ironmongery
Door and window systems and Grade 316 stainless fixings from certified international manufacturers.
Kochi · Questions

Where is Structa Global located in Kochi?
Our headquarters is at KK Buildings, Thoundayil Road, Panampilly Nagar, Kochi, Kerala 682 036. The Kochi team serves architects, contractors and developers across Ernakulam district and Greater Kochi.

Stocked products are delivered within 2 to 5 working days across Kochi and Ernakulam. Lead times for imported or custom-specified materials are confirmed at quotation.

Yes. Our full green building range is available from Kochi, including low-carbon alternatives, FSC-certified timber and high-performance façade systems, with the product data each IGBC, LEED or GRIHA credit requires.

Yes. Call +91 99471 06111 or email hello@structaglobal.com to arrange a sample review with a specification specialist, Monday to Saturday, 9:00 to 18:00 IST.

## Architectural building materials in Trivandrum.
Façade systems, structural components, interior finishes and green building materials for architects, contractors and developers across Thiruvananthapuram, from the Technopark corridor to government and institutional projects.
Our Trivandrum service area
### Local knowledge, headquarters support.
We have had a dedicated Trivandrum team since 2010. Specifications are prepared with our Kochi technical team, and deliveries are scheduled to suit each site.
As Kerala's capital, Thiruvananthapuram has a high share of government, institutional and IT-sector buildings. That means GRIHA requirements on public projects, LEED on multinational campuses, and high solar and thermal loads throughout the year.
Typical projects: Government and institutional buildings, IT corridor offices, residential developments, hospitality and infrastructure.

Standards
ISO 9001:2015 · CE · BIS · ASTM · IGBC, LEED and GRIHA data
Local intelligence
### What Trivandrum asks of a specification.
Three considerations we raise on almost every project here.
- 01 
#### Solar heat gain
High year-round solar radiation makes glazing selection decisive. Specify solar-control, low-E double glazing with a low solar heat gain coefficient on east and west elevations.
- 02 
#### Coastal corrosion
Projects near Kovalam, Shangumugham and the coastline need the same chloride precautions as Kochi: Grade 316 fixings and marine-grade coatings.
- 03 
#### Public-sector compliance

# Façade Systems for Kerala's Coastal Climate | Structa Global
URL: https://www.structaglobal.com/blog/facade-systems-kerala/

- Home 
- Insights 
- How to specify façade systems for Kerala's coastal climate
Façades · Technical guide · 8 min
## How to specify façade systems for Kerala's coastal climate
Structa Global Technical Team Published 1 May 2025 Updated 19 October 2026 
Key points
- Within 1 to 5 km of the coast, design for chloride corrosion first.
- Grade 316 stainless fixings as a minimum. Avoid Grade 304 near the sea.
- Marine-grade anodising (25 microns+) or PVDF to AAMA 2605.
- Require CE marking to EN 13830 and independent air, water and structural tests.
Kerala's coastline runs for around 580 kilometres, and much of the state's new construction sits within reach of its salt air. Sea winds carry chlorides inland, the south-west monsoon brings sustained wind-driven rain, and humidity stays high all year. For a façade, these are the design conditions, not edge cases.
This guide sets out what we check when specifying façade systems for Kochi, Kozhikode, Trivandrum, Thrissur and Kottayam, drawing on two decades of supplying façades across the state.
### Why inland specifications fall short on the coast
A system that performs well in Bengaluru can deteriorate quickly in Kochi. Four conditions account for most failures:
- Chloride corrosion. Salt carried on sea winds attacks exposed metals, especially at joints, fixings and cut edges. Within roughly 1 to 5 kilometres of the shoreline it is a primary design consideration.
- Monsoon wind and rain. Systems must be designed for the wind pressure at the site and height, and tested for water tightness under that pressure.
- Thermal movement. High solar gain and daily temperature swings make the façade expand and contract. Joints and sealants must absorb that movement without losing their seal.
- Biological growth. Persistent humidity encourages algae, moss and mould, particularly on shaded elevations.
Coastal specification is a discipline of its own, and it starts with material selection.
### Material selection for coastal Kerala
#### Aluminium framing and coatings
Correctly specified aluminium remains the most reliable framing material for coastal façades. The protection matters as much as the alloy. For sites near the sea, specify either anodising to at least 25 microns (marine grade) or a PVDF coating tested to AAMA 2605 or QUALICOAT Class 3. Ask for the coating applicator's certification, not only the system manufacturer's.
#### Stainless steel fixings
Exposed fixings, anchors and ironmongery on coastal façades should be Grade 316 stainless steel as a minimum, with 316L or duplex grades for the most exposed positions. Avoid Grade 304 within 2 kilometres of the coast: its lower chloride resistance shortens service life significantly.
#### Glass
Solar-control glass with a low-E coating reduces cooling loads while keeping visible light transmission high. Double-glazed units with warm-edge spacers give the best balance of thermal performance and durability. In India, float glass should comply with IS 14900.
#### Sealants
Neutral-cure silicone sealants offer better UV resistance, temperature stability and adhesion than acetoxy-cure alternatives in this climate. Confirm compatibility with every adjacent material, and check that the sealant's movement capability exceeds the calculated movement of the joint.
### Certifications to require
- CE marking to EN 13830 , the European product standard for curtain walling, with a Declaration of Performance covering structural, air, water and thermal characteristics.
- BIS compliance for products sold in India, for example IS 733 for wrought aluminium sections and IS 14900 for float glass, with mill certificates traceable to the alloy or batch.
- Independent air, water and structural test reports to CWCT or AAMA methods, at pressures matching your design wind load.
- Green building documentation for IGBC or LEED projects: thermal performance data, recycled content and Environmental Product Declarations.
### Engage early
The façade projects that run most smoothly share one trait: the supplier was involved at concept design. At that stage we can help define performance criteria and identify suitable systems before the design is fixed. Late changes to a façade specification are expensive, slow and usually compromise the design intent.
### Frequently asked questions
Which stainless steel grade should be used for façade fixings in coastal Kerala?
Use Grade 316 stainless steel as a minimum for exposed fixings, with 316L or duplex grades for highly exposed positions. Avoid Grade 304 within about 2 km of the coast.
What coating should aluminium façades have near the sea?
Marine-grade anodising of at least 25 microns, or a PVDF coating tested to AAMA 2605 or QUALICOAT Class 3, applied by a certified applicator.
Which standard covers curtain walling for CE marking?
EN 13830 is the European product standard for curtain walling. A CE-marked system should come with a Declaration of Performance to that standard.
To discuss a specification, email hello@structaglobal.com or call +91 99471 06111 . We reply within one business day.
Related: IGBC, LEED or GRIHA for your project · Kochi · Kozhikode

# IGBC vs LEED vs GRIHA: Which Certification? | Structa Global
URL: https://www.structaglobal.com/blog/igbc-leed-griha/

- Home 
- Insights 
- IGBC, LEED or GRIHA: which certification suits your project?
Green building · Guide · 10 min
## IGBC, LEED or GRIHA: which certification suits your project?
Structa Global Technical Team Published 1 April 2025 Updated 19 October 2026 
Key points
- All three systems rate buildings. Materials contribute to credits.
- IGBC: Certified from 40 points, Super Platinum from 90.
- LEED: Certified from 40 points, Platinum from 80.
- GRIHA: one star from 25 points, five stars from 86.
Green certification is now a baseline expectation for many institutional, commercial and public projects in Kerala. The question is which framework to use. IGBC, LEED and GRIHA share a goal but differ in scoring, administration and the projects they suit.
One point first: all three rate whole buildings, not products. A material cannot be "IGBC certified". It can contribute to credits, and the supplier's job is to provide the evidence those credits require.
### IGBC: Indian Green Building Council
IGBC was set up by the Confederation of Indian Industry and is the most widely used rating system in India. It covers new buildings, existing buildings, homes, factories, townships and campuses. Its credit categories include Sustainable Architecture and Design, Site Selection and Planning, Water Conservation, Energy Efficiency, Building Materials and Resources, and Indoor Environmental Quality.
#### IGBC Green New Buildings levels
Level Points 
Certified 40 to 49 
Silver 50 to 59 
Gold 60 to 74 
Platinum 75 to 89 
Super Platinum 90 to 100 
Best suited to most private commercial, residential, institutional, hospitality and mixed-use projects in India, with a strong regional network of consultants.
### LEED: Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design
LEED is administered by the US Green Building Council and is used in more than 180 countries and territories. In India it is common on IT parks, corporate campuses and buildings for multinational occupiers. It is also the standard framework for our projects in the USA and Canada.
#### LEED levels
Level Points 
Certified 40 to 49 
Silver 50 to 59 
Gold 60 to 79 
Platinum 80 and above 
Materials credits reward Environmental Product Declarations, responsible sourcing of raw materials, material ingredient reporting and low-emitting materials. We supply EPDs, ingredient disclosures and VOC test data for the products we specify.
### GRIHA: Green Rating for Integrated Habitat Assessment
GRIHA is India's national rating system, developed by TERI with the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy. It is widely required on central and state government projects, and public authorities offer incentives such as faster approvals and additional floor area for rated buildings. GRIHA scores out of 100 points plus 5 innovation points.
#### GRIHA star ratings
Rating Points 
1 star 25 to 40 
2 stars 41 to 55 
3 stars 56 to 70 
4 stars 71 to 85 
5 stars 86 and above 
Best suited to government offices, hospitals, schools, universities and public-private partnership projects.
Choose the framework your client, tenant or authority will recognise, then specify to its credits.
### How to choose
- Government or public sector: GRIHA, and check the brief for a required star rating.
- Multinational occupier, IT park or international investor: LEED, for its global recognition.
- Private commercial, residential, hospitality or institutional: IGBC, usually the most practical route in India.
- Large mixed-use or campus developments: consider dual certification, typically IGBC with LEED.
Our sustainability team maps products to the credits your project is targeting and assembles the evidence for submission.
### Frequently asked questions
Can a building material be IGBC or LEED certified?
No. IGBC, LEED and GRIHA certify buildings. Materials contribute to credits, supported by evidence such as Environmental Product Declarations, recycled-content data and VOC test reports.
What are the IGBC Green New Buildings certification levels?
Certified 40 to 49 points, Silver 50 to 59, Gold 60 to 74, Platinum 75 to 89 and Super Platinum 90 to 100.
How many points are needed for a GRIHA 5-star rating?
86 points or more. The GRIHA thresholds are 25 to 40 for one star, 41 to 55 for two, 56 to 70 for three, 71 to 85 for four and 86 and above for five.
To discuss a specification, email hello@structaglobal.com or call +91 99471 06111 . We reply within one business day.
Related: Our sustainability commitments · Certifications

# Sourcing Architectural Materials in Kerala | Structa Global
URL: https://www.structaglobal.com/blog/sourcing-materials-kerala/

- Home 
- Insights 
- The architect's guide to sourcing building materials in Kerala
Specification · Guide · 12 min
## The architect's guide to sourcing building materials in Kerala
Structa Global Technical Team Published 1 March 2025 Updated 19 October 2026 
Key points
- Define performance requirements before choosing products.
- Judge the supplier's documentation and technical capability, not only the product.
- Verify original, current certificates for the exact product.
- Plan lead times at specification: 2 to 5 days stocked, 8 to 16 weeks custom.
Sourcing decisions made at specification stage have larger consequences than ever: tighter programmes, stricter green building requirements and higher performance expectations. This guide sets out the sequence we recommend to architects, project managers and procurement teams in Kerala.
### Stage 1: Define performance before products
The most common error is to choose a product and then fit the specification around it. Define the requirement first, then find the products that meet it. For each material category, the brief should cover:
- Functional performance: structural capacity, thermal U-value, acoustic reduction, fire resistance and weather tightness.
- Durability: design life, maintenance regime and performance under coastal exposure, monsoon and UV.
- Certification: ISO, CE, BIS and ASTM as applicable, plus the green building credits targeted.
- Appearance: colour, texture, reflectivity and finish.
- Sustainability: recycled content, embodied carbon, FSC certification and EPD availability.
- Commercial terms: budget range, required lead time and minimum quantities.
The specification drives the sourcing, not the other way round.
### Stage 2: Evaluate the supplier, not only the product
A certified product from an unreliable distributor carries the same project risk as a poor product from a reliable one. Check that the supplier has:
- ISO 9001:2015 certification covering procurement, testing, storage and delivery.
- Technical capability to review drawings and recommend products against your performance requirements.
- Complete documentation for every product: mill certificates, test reports, EPDs, CE Declarations of Performance and BIS compliance.
- Honest lead times with real visibility of the supply chain.
- Regional experience of Kochi's coastal exposure, Thrissur's rainfall and the conditions of each market.
### Stage 3: Verify certifications
- Ask for the original certificate, not a copy or a website reference.
- Check that it is current and covers the exact product and grade being specified.
- For CE-marked products, ask for the Declaration of Performance, not just the mark.
- For IGBC or LEED contributions, ask for the product data that supports each credit.
- For BIS certification, confirm the IS code number applies to the specified product.
### Stage 4: Plan the supply timeline at specification stage
Late material delivery is one of the most common and most avoidable causes of programme delay. Typical lead times in Kerala are:
Product type Typical lead time 
Stocked standard products 2 to 5 working days in Kochi and Ernakulam; 3 to 7 elsewhere in Kerala 
Imported standard products 4 to 8 weeks, depending on origin and shipping schedule 
Custom specifications 8 to 16 weeks, including production, testing and shipping 
Large-volume orders Phased deliveries planned with our logistics team at quotation 
### Stage 5: Treat the supplier as part of the design team
Projects that finish on time, to specification and within budget usually share one trait: a supplier brought in early and treated as a project partner. We engage at specification, advise through procurement and support delivery and installation. Our involvement ends when the building performs as specified.
### Frequently asked questions
What is the typical lead time for architectural materials in Kerala?
Stocked products take 2 to 5 working days in Kochi and Ernakulam and 3 to 7 elsewhere in Kerala. Imported standard products take 4 to 8 weeks, and custom specifications 8 to 16 weeks.
What documents should a building materials supplier provide?
Mill certificates, accredited test reports, CE Declarations of Performance, BIS compliance certificates, Environmental Product Declarations, safety data sheets and warranty documents.
When should a materials supplier be involved in a project?
At concept or early design stage, before the specification is fixed, so performance criteria and lead times can shape the design rather than constrain it.
To discuss a specification, email hello@structaglobal.com or call +91 99471 06111 . We reply within one business day.
